text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport, meet the conditions set by the Nationality Law of the PRC, Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC. 2. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, with proper moral conduct, friendly to China, between the ages of 18 and 22, and have attained a senior high school diploma. 3. For English Taught Program：Applicants whose native language is not English should submit an English proficiency certificate within two years, such as the result of TOEFL（90 or above）, IELTS（6 or above）or proof of all courses taught in English issued by high school or other English proficiency certificate. 4. CSCA subjects requirements download here . Note: The university may assign students to the Hangzhou International campus, if you apply for this program, you should be willing to accept this arrangement.
